title: Annotatio II §.VI close: Neither this nor prior Dissensus judged Fundamental — Tractatus prior refs; stop before Annotatio III
pass_a_gloss: meanwhile judging neither this, nor any of the preceding Dissensus, to be Fundamental — in the earlier Tractate from number 23 to 35, number 45, and from number 76 to 82 inclusive.
pass_b_english: And they still did not count this split — or any of the earlier ones — as Fundamental: see the earlier Tractate, nos. 23–35, no. 45, and nos. 76–82 inclusive.
source_text: interim nec hunc, nec antecedentium Dissensuum quemquam, Fundamentalem arbitrati, Tractatuló priori à num. 23. ad 35. num. 45. & à num. 76. ad 82, inclusivè.

lemmas.latin: nec hunc, nec antecedentium Dissensuum quemquam
lemmas.gloss: neither this nor any of the preceding Dissensus

lemmas.latin: à num. 23. ad 35. num. 45. & à num. 76. ad 82, inclusivè
lemmas.gloss: from no. 23 to 35, no. 45, and from no. 76 to 82 inclusive

notes: Hexades Annotatio II §.VI densify §194; closes §.VI before Annotatio III De Moliminibus.
